results.snippet: How many chromosomes do humans have? Humans have 23 pairs of chromosomes, for a total of 46 chromosomes. In fact, each species of plants and animals has a set number of chromosomes.

results.snippet: Chromosomes come in pairs, so no human or animal will normally have an odd number of chromosomes. For example, you can find four pairs of chromosomes in a fruit fly, and 12 in a rice plant.

results.snippet: Human cells have 23 pairs of chromosomes (22 pairs of autosomes and one pair of sex chromosomes), giving a total of 46 per cell. In addition to these, human cells have many hundreds of copies of the mitochondrial genome.
